name: Reconnaissance Command Burst
description: Detects multiple endpoint discovery commands (whoami, hostname, net user, id, ipconfig, ifconfig) executed within a short time window.
explanation: Adversaries perform situational awareness discovery immediately after gaining initial access to enumerate privileges and host identity.
investigation_steps: Correlate the parent process that invoked these reconnaissance commands.
Determine if the parent process is a shell spawned by a web server, macro, or unexpected service.
Review user authentication logs for unexpected interactive sessions.
